_comment: Copy this to data/rules.json and edit. Rules are checked top to bottom;
the first match wins, and a rule match skips both the memory and LLM tiers.
category    required. Category name, "Group > Name" path, or numeric id.
match       required. JavaScript regex source (a string).
amount_min  match only if abs(amount) >= this.
amount_max  match only if abs(amount) <= this.
account_ids array of plaid/manual account ids to restrict the rule to.
notes       note text stamped onto the transaction when the rule fires.
review      true/false to override --mark-reviewed for this rule only.
